title: Plakar Immich Dump Importer Connector Config

location.description: Immich server, immich+dump://host[:port][/prefix]; https unless the host is loopback or plaintext is set

api_key.description: Immich API key of an admin; PLAKAR_IMMICH_API_KEY in the environment takes precedence

upload_location.description: The server's UPLOAD_LOCATION on this host; when set, its files are backed up after the dump, thumbs/ and encoded-video/ left out

dump_timeout.description: How long to wait for the backup-database job, as a Go duration

insecure.description: Do not verify the server's TLS certificate
